text: Astronomy covers many scientific fields, ranging from looking at space objects to sensing gravitational waves. The telescope stands out as one of the most interesting tools in this domain because it changed how people understand the cosmos. Beyond helping us see faraway stars and planets, these instruments allowed scientists to identify nebulae, which are huge clouds of gas and dust found between stars. Learning about nebulae is vital for grasping how galaxies form. Finding these objects has also created fresh paths for scientific investigation.
